description: This file defines classes and structures related to User Equipment (UE) context management within a Distributed Unit (DU) in a 5G RAN, including context data, controller interface, and UE class with associated resources and mobility management.

classes.name: du_ue_context
classes.description: Holds the context information of a UE in the DU, including identifiers and cell info.

classes.name: du_ue_controller
classes.description: Interface for controlling and interacting with the state of a DU UE, including RLF detection and traffic management.

classes.name: du_ue
classes.description: Represents a DU UE, extending context and controller, managing bearers, resources, and mobility state.

methods.name: disable_rlf_detection
methods.description: Disables RLF detection for the UE.

methods.name: handle_activity_stop_request
methods.description: Stops traffic and RLF detection for the UE, with an option to stop SRBs.

methods.name: handle_drb_stop_request
methods.description: Stops traffic for specified DRBs of the UE.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for the UE.

methods.name: handle_rlf_detection
methods.description: Handles detection of Radio Link Failure (RLF) with a specified cause.

methods.name: handle_crnti_ce_detection
methods.description: Handles detection of a C-RNTI MAC Control Element for the UE.

methods.name: get_mac_rlf_notifier
methods.description: Provides access to the MAC RLF notifier.

methods.name: get_rlc_rlf_notifier
methods.description: Provides access to the RLC RLF notifier.
